sections.heading: Each round
lines: Channel shows 2 ships. Both keepers secretly pick 1 Signal (0–5) and reveal together.
HIGHER Signal wins the beam: move the Tide 1 space toward you.
But the LOWER Signal picks a ship first (bright light steers the Tide; a dim light grabs the cargo). The beam winner takes the other ship.
Tie: Tide stays; the First Keeper picks first. Then refill the Channel to 2.

sections.heading: Each Night (4 rounds)
lines: You hold 6 Signals and commit 4 — choose which 2 to hold back.
Night end: the Tide side scores 2 points per space from centre (max 6).
The tide turns: the keeper who LOST the Tide takes the First-Keeper token. Reset the Tide to centre; take all Signals back.

sections.heading: Scoring (after Night 3)
lines: Convoy: +2 for each set of ⬢ Cargo + ◆ Passenger + ▲ Naval.
Run: +2 for each 3 consecutive values in one suit.
Plus your Tide bonuses. Most points wins — tie: most ▲ Naval.

sections.heading: The question every round
lines: Grab the cargo in front of you (bid low) — or push the Tide for the end-of-Night bonus (bid high)?
